title: OpenAI 'temporarily' pauses new sign-ups and upgrades to $200 plan
content:
Note: As of September 10, 2026, we’re temporarily pausing new sign-ups and upgrades to the ChatGPT Pro $200 plan (Pro 20X). This includes sign-ups and upgrades from Free, Go, Plus, or Pro $100. Existing ChatGPT Pro $200 subscriptions and new or existing ChatGPT Pro $100 subscriptions are not affected by this pause.
If you cancel or schedule a downgrade, you keep Pro $200 until the end of your current billing cycle and can undo the change in billing settings before the cycle ends. Once your Pro $200 subscription ends, you cannot purchase it again until the pause is lifted.
Read the Pro $200 pause FAQ for more information on how the pause may affect your subscription.
Overview
ChatGPT Pro is designed for people who rely on AI to get high-stakes, complex work done.
All Pro tiers include access to advanced features, including:
- Pro models
- Codex
- Deep research
- Image creation
- Memory
- File uploads
Access and usage allowances
The ChatGPT Pro plan includes access to GPT-5 and legacy models. Some models have separate usage allowances. Usage must also adhere to our Terms of Use, which prohibits, among other things:
- Abusive usage, such as automatically or programmatically extracting data.
- Sharing your account credentials or making your account available to anyone else.
- Reselling access or using ChatGPT to power third-party services.
OpenAI uses guardrails to help prevent misuse. These guardrails may occasionally result in a temporary usage restriction. ChatGPT will notify you if this happens. If you believe a restriction was applied by mistake, contact OpenAI Support through the chat widget at help.openai.com. If OpenAI does not find policy-violating behavior, access will be restored.
Pro $200 (Pro 20x) new subscription pause FAQ
Can I upgrade to the Pro $100 or Pro $200 plan during the pause?
You can upgrade to Pro $100 from the Pricing page or from Settings → My Plan, but you cannot upgrade to the Pro $200 plan, since new subscriptions and upgrades to Pro $200 are temporarily paused. If you are on Free, Go, Plus, or Pro $100, you cannot move to Pro $200 until the pause is lifted.
When you upgrade to Pro $100,  the new usage limits and capabilities apply immediately. 
Is my existing Pro $200 subscription affected?
No. Existing Pro $200 subscriptions continue to renew as usual. Pro $200 remains the highest usage tier, and the Pro $100 plan remains available for people who want Pro capabilities with lower usage.
What happens if my Pro $200 renewal payment fails?
If you subscribe through chatgpt.com and your renewal payment fails, we'll send you an email to the address associated with the account with information on options you have to renew the account. If you take no action, and your subscription is canceled, you cannot purchase Pro $200 again until the pause is lifted. If you subscribe through Apple or Google Play, follow your app store’s payment-recovery instructions.
Can I change between the Pro $100 and Pro $200 tiers during the pause?
If you schedule a downgrade from Pro $200 to Pro $100, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle. You keep Pro $200 until then and can undo the downgrade in billing settings before the cycle ends. Once the downgrade takes effect, you cannot upgrade from Pro $100 to Pro $200 until the pause is lifted.
What happens if I canceled my Pro $200 subscription before or during the pause?
If a cancellation is scheduled but your Pro $200 subscription is still active, you keep Pro $200 until the end of your current billing cycle and can undo the cancellation in billing settings before the cycle ends. This applies whether you scheduled the cancellation before or during the pause. If the cancellation takes effect and your account moves to Free, you cannot purchase Pro $200 again until the pause is lifted.
Can I keep Pro $200 if I join a ChatGPT Business workspace?
Yes. Your personal Pro subscription and Business workspace subscription are independent, so joining a Business workspace does not require you to cancel Pro $200. If you cancel your personal Pro $200 subscription, the standard cancellation rules above apply.
What happens if my Pro $200 subscription is refunded?
If a refund also cancels your Pro $200 subscription, your access ends immediately and your account moves to Free. You cannot purchase Pro $200 again until the pause is lifted.
What happens if claiming a promotion changes my Pro $200 subscription?
Review the promotion’s terms before you claim it. If claiming an offer ends your Pro $200 subscription or moves you to another plan, you cannot switch back to Pro $200 while new purchases are paused.
Can I use a Pro $200 promotion during the pause?
No. New Pro $200 promo redemptions are paused. If you already redeemed a Pro $200 promotion and your subscription is active, it is unaffected. Promotions for usage credits are separate and remain subject to their own eligibility and redemption terms.
General FAQ
What’s the difference between the two Pro tiers?
Both Pro tiers include the same core capabilities. The main difference is usage allowance: Pro $100 unlocks 5x higher usage than Plus, while Pro $200 unlocks 20x usage than Plus.
Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
Yes. You can change or cancel your subscription anytime from Settings → My Plan. If you upgrade to an available plan, your new plan takes effect immediately and your billing cycle starts over. If you move to a lower tier, the change takes effect at your next renewal and you keep your current plan until then. If you cancel, you keep access until the end of your billing period, and your plan will not renew. If you currently have Pro $200, read the Pro $200 pause FAQ in this article before you change or cancel your plan.
Is there an annual plan available?
Currently, we do not support annual billing or the option to pay for multiple months in advance for ChatGPT Go, Plus, or Pro subscriptions.
How do I request a VAT exemption?
If you would like to request a VAT exemption request, please refer to our article: How do I submit a VAT exemption request?
Why is a model temporarily unavailable on ChatGPT Pro?
Some models have separate usage allowances on ChatGPT Pro, and allowances can differ by Pro tier. The $100 Pro tier includes lower usage allowances than the $200 Pro tier.
When you reach a model's allowance, that model may be temporarily unavailable until the allowance resets. ChatGPT displays the reset time when available.
Reaching a model's allowance does not by itself mean that your account was restricted or that your subscription ended. You can use another available model or wait until the displayed reset time. There is no setting to increase or bypass a model's usage allowance.
If the model remains unavailable after the displayed reset time, contact OpenAI Support through the chat widget at help.openai.com.
Can Support reset my usage limits?
No. OpenAI Support does not reset ChatGPT or Codex usage limits. If you reach a limit, wait until it resets or use another available option shown in your account.
If you believe your usage was counted incorrectly, or access has not returned after the stated reset time, contact Support so we can investigate.

report.summary: OpenAI has temporarily paused new sign-ups and upgrades to its $200 ChatGPT Pro tier, while existing $200 subscribers and the $100 Pro tier remain unaffected.
report.background: The pause arrives as AI providers juggle soaring demand for frontier models against finite GPU capacity. OpenAI's Pro tiers are aimed at high-stakes users and include GPT-5, Codex, deep research, image creation, memory, and file uploads. Pro $100 offers 5x Plus usage; Pro $200 offers 20x. By closing new $200 sign-ups, OpenAI appears to manage compute and abuse risks without cutting existing high-end subscribers. The FAQ stresses guardrails, per-model allowances, and no annual billing. It also warns that canceling, downgrading, refunds, failed payments, or promotions can end access and prevent repurchase until the pause lifts. The move mirrors a broader industry pattern of tiered access, waitlists, and capacity rationing amid rapid AI adoption.
key_points: Scope of the pause: Only new sign-ups and upgrades to ChatGPT Pro $200 are blocked. Existing Pro $200 subscriptions renew normally, and new or existing Pro $100 subscriptions are unaffected. Users on Free, Go, Plus, or Pro $100 cannot move to Pro $200 until OpenAI lifts the pause.

Cancellation lockout risk: If you cancel or schedule a downgrade from Pro $200, you keep access until your current billing cycle ends. You can undo the change before then. But once the subscription ends, you cannot buy Pro $200 again while the pause is active.

Tier differences: Both Pro tiers share core features such as Pro models, Codex, deep research, image creation, memory, and uploads. The key difference is usage: Pro $100 gives 5x Plus usage, while Pro $200 gives 20x. Some models also have separate allowances.

Promotions and payment failures: New Pro $200 promo redemptions are paused. If a renewal payment fails and the subscription cancels, or if a refund ends access, you cannot repurchase Pro $200 until the pause lifts. Existing redeemed promotions remain active if the subscription is active.

Support cannot reset limits: Guardrails may temporarily restrict usage for abuse or policy violations. If you hit a model allowance, ChatGPT shows a reset time; Support cannot reset ChatGPT or Codex limits. If access does not return after the reset, contact Support.
report.impact: For the AI industry, the pause signals that even premium subscription demand can outrun serving capacity and anti-abuse controls. It may push high-volume developers and teams toward APIs, Business/Enterprise workspaces, or rival platforms like Claude and Gemini. For developers, $200 Pro is a high-limit prototyping and agentic-work tool; losing new access could disrupt scaling unless they already hold seats. Regular users are largely unaffected: Pro $100 remains available, and Plus or lower tiers continue. The biggest risk is for existing $200 subscribers who cancel, downgrade, or suffer payment failure, because they may be locked out until OpenAI resumes sales.
report.tools: Follow OpenAI's ChatGPT Pro help center and Pro $200 pause FAQ for live updates. Developers can compare capacity and usage through the OpenAI API platform, Codex, OpenRouter, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or local runners like Ollama and LM Studio. For subscription management, watch OpenAI's pricing page, billing settings, and status page.
